The CoE “simplified allocation methodology” for field office costs was developed and subsequently adopted by the Committee of Ministers of the Council of Europe (CM) Decision CM/Del/Dec(2016)1268/11.6 to make the “simplified allocation methodology” part of the internal regulations. This methodology has been assessed by the Commission ex-anté. For 2026, the flat rate amounts to 347 euros per month per local staff. This rate is updated each year based on actual costs of the previous year. This flat rate covers office rent cost, electricity, heating, maintenance, cleaning, security, fixed telephone costs, internet access.
